detail.title: 一种柔性吸盘夹具
detail.abstract: The invention discloses a flexible sucker clamp which consists of a bottom plate, an electric push rod, a movable plate, a sucker device, a side plate and a ball screw. The bottom plate is fixed on the workstation, through control ball drive curb plate longitudinal movement, through control electric putter drive curb plate lateral shifting, realize the centre gripping to the target object in a flexible way, the extension length of the steerable sucking disc of miniature electric putter, thereby better hug closely the target object surface, the sucking disc device passes through the trachea connector and is connected with air exhaust device, can realize adsorbing the negative pressure of target object, a flexible sucking disc anchor clamps is connected with external server, the profile data of target object can be access to the server, this sucking disc anchor clamps can be according to server instruction automatically regulated, the realization is fixed to the centre gripping of target object, this sucking disc anchor clamps flexibility, it is compatible strong, be applicable to the target object of different profile shapes.
